mostWorthwhile.text: Building the surface barrier was most worthwhile: it explained how dead outer cells protect the body while living cells replace them.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the supply network to the arm felt predictable, especially as it was the only offered combination.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the protective outermost skin cells are no longer living and are continually replaced from below.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the offered combinations had clear purposes, although the final choices were straightforward.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it explored a new problem, because the connections between skin, supply and control were useful, though the choices became predictable.
